textos.As opiniões convergem ao avaliar o rotei: Opinions converge in assessing the script and structure of the work, but disagree on its effectiveness. While most of those who recommend the film value the portrayal of the spiral of violence and hatred, most of those who do not recommend it criticize the characters for finding them unlikable and lacking charisma.
textos.Muitas reviews descrevem o filme como ar: Many reviews describe the film as dragging, with long stretches of talking and walking that lead nowhere, making the experience tedious and hard to finish.
textos.Os personagens são frequentemente critic: The characters are often criticized for being irritating, immature and hard to root for, which prevents any emotional connection with the story.
textos.Várias reviews apontam que o filme carec: Several reviews point out that the film lacks a substantive plot, with minimal events and no dramatic progression, seeming more like an empty portrait than an engaging narrative.
textos.Algumas críticas mencionam que os diálog: Some reviews mention that the dialogue is repetitive, poorly written or disjointed, contributing to the feeling that the film does not develop.
textos.Muitos expressam decepção por considerar: Many express disappointment because they consider the film overrated, not understanding the high regard it receives, and feel that it does not meet the expectations it has created.
textos.A escolha do preto e branco é vista por: The choice of black and white is seen by some as pretentious or unnecessary, while others acknowledge beautiful shots but think the style does not sustain the film.
textos.Várias reviews medianas consideram que o: Several middling reviews consider the film dragging, with repetitive moments and a sense that the plot does not move forward, making the experience boring for a portion of the group.
textos.Alguns espectadores deste grupo relatam: Some viewers in this group report not having become attached to the protagonists, feeling indifferent to what happens to them, which hurt emotional involvement.
textos.Elogios à fotografia e à direção: Praise for the cinematography and direction
textos.Apesar das ressalvas, muitas reviews med: Despite their reservations, many middling reviews acknowledge the quality of the black-and-white cinematography, the composition of the shots and the effectiveness of the direction as strengths of the film.
textos.A atuação do trio principal, em especial: The acting of the main trio, especially that of Vincent Cassel, is often highlighted as convincing and natural, even by those who did not like the film as a whole.
textos.Crítica à abordagem do tema e à mensagem: Criticism of the approach to the theme and the message
textos.Algumas reviews medianas apontam que a m: Some middling reviews point out that the message about violence and the cycle of hatred is important, but conveyed in a repetitive, preachy or not very subtle way, which weakens its impact.
textos.Vários integrantes deste grupo esperavam: Several members of this group expected more because of the acclaim, but were disappointed because they did not find the film as striking or engaging as expected.
textos.A escolha do preto e branco é frequentem: The choice of black and white is often praised for creating a unique, realistic atmosphere, with striking framing that turns each scene into something visually powerful.
textos.Muitas reviews destacam como o filme ret: Many reviews highlight how the film portrays violence and hatred as a cycle that perpetuates itself, fed by social inequality and lack of prospects.
textos.As críticas ressaltam a abordagem do rac: The reviews emphasize the treatment of institutional racism, social exclusion and police brutality, presented in a raw way and without romanticization.
textos.A construção dos três protagonistas e as: The construction of the three protagonists and the performances are praised for making the characters realistic and complex, each representing distinct perspectives.
textos.O filme é descrito como capaz de manter: The film is described as able to keep the viewer in suspense, creating a feeling that something bad is always about to happen.
textos.Várias reviews mencionam o forte impacto: Several reviews mention the strong emotional impact, leaving the audience shaken and reflective about the issues presented.

textos.Lançado em 1995 e dirigido por Mathieu K: Released in 1995 and directed by Mathieu Kassovitz, the drama La Haine portrays a day in the life of three young men of Arab, Jewish and Black origins who live in a poor housing project in Paris. The plot follows the escalation of tensions caused by racial discrimination carried out by hostile police officers.
textos.A obra é estruturada em uma cinematograf: The work is structured around an entirely black-and-white cinematography, composing a dense, raw visual atmosphere. The experience unfolds at a slow pace, following the characters' daily lives and wanderings continuously.
textos.Os grupos concordam sobre o que o filme: The groups agree on what the film is and address the same topics, but diverge sharply on the verdict of whether it works. Among the vast majority of ratings (~93%), many highlight the black-and-white cinematography and aesthetics as central points. In addition, a significant share emphasizes the depiction of the cycle of violence and hatred, while a considerable number stress the social critique aimed at racism and police conduct.
textos.Para quem está numa fração mínima das no: For those in a minimal fraction of the ratings (~5%), a good portion point to the slow, repetitive pace as an obstacle, and several report difficulty connecting with the characters, although a significant share maintain praise for the cinematography and direction.
textos.Nessa leitura expressa numa fração ainda: In this reading, expressed in an even smaller fraction of the ratings (~1%), most reject the film for its slow, boring pace. About half see the characters as unpleasant and lacking charisma, and a good portion criticize the lack of plot and dramatic development.
